title: suspension-automation-policy
description: Whether an AUTOMATED (webhook-triggered) destructive deployment action is allowed to run unattended, or requires human approval first (issue #94 acceptance criteria: 'Require approval or explicit documented automation policy before destructive deployment actions caused by non-payment'). `resource_policy_id` references the underlying catalog-resource-policy (issue #92) that says WHAT happens (allow/block/stop/keep_running); this contract only adds WHETHER a non-payment webhook event may apply that policy without a human approval step. `requires_approval` defaults conceptually to true everywhere in this contract set's fixtures - an automation policy that skips approval is an explicit, reviewable opt-in, never the default.
